films.title: Pick your roll
films.subtitle: Every sample below is the same scene through a different film — rendered live by the same engine as the camera.
films.note: New stocks and limited rolls drop with the seasons. Film names are ChainRoll's own, not real film brands.

1.name: KUB 400
1.body: Warm, slightly faded blacks, like colour film from the corner lab — good every day, in any light.

2.name: Mono 400
2.body: Hard-contrast black and white with chunky grain — made for people, streets and harsh noon light.

3.name: Night 800
3.body: Cool tones for after dark; bright lights bloom into red halos — neon, street lamps, night markets.

how.title: From shutter to chain
how.subtitle: ChainRoll is a film camera where every frame is a transaction on KUB Chain — a little slower, and every photo counts.

steps.title: Claim
steps.body: Connect a wallet and claim one free roll a day (24 frames), resetting at midnight Thai time. Pick the film first — once loaded, it's yours until the roll ends.

steps.title: Shoot
steps.body: Each frame gets a fingerprint (hash) that's recorded on-chain. The photo stays latent — invisible until developed, just like real film.

steps.title: Develop
steps.body: After 24 frames, send the roll to develop. About an hour in the darkroom, then the whole roll fades in.

steps.title: Share
steps.body: Post your favourites to the feed and get a link to share on LINE or X — nothing you don't post is seen.

how.costBody: Every transaction pays gas in KUB. The numbers below use the 25 Gwei minimum gas price — real prices depend on network load.
privacy: Photos stay on your device (in your browser) — never on-chain.
The chain only stores a hash (a 32-byte fingerprint) that proves the photo was taken at that moment. It can't be turned back into the photo.
On-chain data is public and permanent — your wallet address, timestamps and film choice are visible.
Clearing your browser data deletes photos you haven't saved yet (you can save them after developing).
how.wallets: Bitkub NEXT · MetaMask · OKX · Rabby and other browser wallets · KUB Wallet and mobile wallets via WalletConnect

faq.a: Because that's the magic of film — you shoot without knowing, then see the whole roll at once.

faq.q: Can I delete a bad shot?
faq.a: No. Every click uses a real frame, like film — make each one count.

faq.q: Will my photos follow me to a new device?
faq.a: The on-chain record is always there, but the photos stay on the device you shot with until you post or save them.
A little, for gas (see the table above). Bitkub NEXT users may have a free transaction quota set by Bitkub.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.draft: Draft — under review for Thailand's PDPA before launch.

sections.p: Your wallet address and the KUB Chain transactions you create (claiming, shooting, developing), which are public blockchain data.
Photos are stored only in your browser. We never receive a photo unless you choose to post it. The chain holds only a hash that can't be turned back into the image.
Transactions on KUB Chain are permanent by design and can't be deleted, even if you stop using the service.
Once the feed launches, photos you post are stored on our servers and shown publicly. You can delete a post at any time.
Bitkub NEXT and WalletConnect (Reown) are used to connect wallets and are covered by their own policies.
You can ask to see, correct or delete any data we hold off-chain. Contact details for the ChainRoll team will be published before launch.
